prompt:
You are checking which candidate answer correctly answers a question about a SQL database.

Question:
Retrieve the names of players who scored no less than 100 runs in a match while playing for the team that lost that match.

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

[A]
SQL:
WITH ball_runs AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.striker, bs.runs_scored
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
),
player_runs AS (
    SELECT match_id, striker, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM ball_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, striker
),
losing_matches AS (
    SELECT match_id, 
           CASE WHEN match_winner = team_1 THEN team_2 ELSE team_1 END AS losing_team
    FROM match
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM player_runs pr
JOIN losing_matches lm ON pr.match_id = lm.match_id
JOIN player_match pm ON pr.match_id = pm.match_id AND pr.striker = pm.player_id
JOIN player p ON pr.striker = p.player_id
WHERE pr.total_runs >= 100
  AND lm.losing_team = pm.team_id
ORDER BY p.player_name
Result: 7 rows x 1 columns

WITH match_losing_teams AS (
    SELECT match_id,
           CASE WHEN match_winner = team_1 THEN team_2 ELSE team_1 END AS losing_team_id
    FROM match
),
player_runs AS (
    SELECT bs.match_id, bsb.striker, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bsb ON bs.match_id = bsb.match_id AND bs.over_id = bsb.over_id AND bs.ball_id = bsb.ball_id AND bs.innings_no = bsb.innings_no
    WHERE bs.runs_scored IS NOT NULL AND bsb.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bs.match_id, bsb.striker
    HAVING SUM(bs.runs_scored) >= 100
),
player_match_info AS (
    SELECT pr.match_id, pr.striker, pr.total_runs, pm.team_id
    FROM player_runs pr
    JOIN player_match pm ON pr.match_id = pm.match_id AND pr.striker = pm.player_id
),
qualified_players AS (
    SELECT pmi.match_id, pmi.striker, pmi.total_runs, mlt.losing_team_id, p.player_name
    FROM player_match_info pmi
    JOIN match_losing_teams mlt ON pmi.match_id = mlt.match_id AND pmi.team_id = mlt.losing_team_id
    JOIN player p ON pmi.striker = p.player_id
)
SELECT player_name
FROM qualified_players
ORDER BY player_name
